product.name: Festival Special Vichitra Silk Embroidered Semi-Stitched Lehenga Choli
product.description: A traditional festival lehenga choli featuring Vichitra silk fabric with sequence and thread work. The outfit is semi-stitched and includes a lehenga, blouse material and dupatta.

review_summary.summary: All three available ratings are 5-star reviews. Customers praise the appearance, fabric quality, colour and overall value. One reviewer specifically noted that the semi-stitched lehenga requires fitting adjustments and that the blouse material may need additional work or modification.
